thread:
maria: quick sync - debating adding a first-class 'stability' field to model manifests vs extending pins with typed annotations
jon: current pins are overloaded. makes fallback logic brittle
lee: seeing weird evictions in Dedicated; need clearer routing hints
sasha: two paths: (A) add stability enum (stable|canary|experimental|deprecated) + optional stability_score, or (B) extend pin with pin.type/pin.priority metadata
maria: enum is cleaner for router policies. typed pins are more backwards-compatible but more logic-heavy
jon: tenant exceptions? customer A may want experimental in region eu-west-1
anya: allow tenant-route overrides referencing model_id (not mutating manifest) or allow allowlist in route config
lee: prefer separating control planes. let manifests be hints; route configs hold overrides
sasha: migration note: clients must ignore unknown enums. make field optional and additive
maria: propose manifest.schema v2: optional stability enum + optional stability_score (0.0-1.0) + stability_reason string
jon: telemetry: emit model_stability and stability_score in traces
sasha: default stability_score mapping: stable=0.9, canary=0.7, experimental=0.4, deprecated=0.1; manifest may override
lee: router example precedence sketch:
  - explicit_pin
  - tenant_affinity
  - stability-weighted selection (use stability_score)
  - fallback_pool
anya: Dedicated needs weighted selection for cost-aware routing, not strict tiers
maria: rollout hints should live in rollout metadata object (cohorts). keep manifest compact
jon: safety: what should missing/unknown stability default to? stable keeps BC but risky
sasha: agree. recommend default -> experimental for safety, log and alert on missing
maria: consensus: missing/unknown => experimental. add CI warning for manifests missing stability
deploy-bot: note added - manifest.schema v2 will include optional field and CI warns when absent; infra will discuss enforcement
anya: i'll draft migration guide for Dedicated tenants and overrides
sasha: i'll open PR for manifest.schema v2 with enum+score+reason (owner: @sasha) target: EOD Friday
jon: i'll update router policy docs to show stability_score weighting (owner: @jon)
lee: i'll add trace changes to emit model_stability + stability_score (owner: @lee)
maria: sync Friday 10:00 after Sasha PR. small nit: deprecated must be advisory only, not auto-delete
lee: sdk adapters should surface stability and allow filtering by min_stability_score
jon: adding SDK issue now
maria: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
